context.transcript:
Welcome to this instructional video. Many subscribers
to my channel have asked about installing ceiling fans,
so I thought I'd help. ® Your first steps are to shut off the
electricity in the room, put on protective eye covering, and
make sure you have a sturdy ladder. ° These are essential
for your safety. Once the electricity is off, hold the base of
the fan to the ceiling and draw a circle around it with a pencil.
Then, ®cut along the circle with a drywall saw. ® The saw
will shake quite strongly so I suggest asking a friend to hold
LEEZATESSELEBHOURT.
the ladder while you do it.
